items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I didn't even know him. About him. About him.

ctx.x: Well, seven or eight years, I guess. A long time. See, to understand, I got Nene, he had a, was up there, had a barber shop, didn't he? I don't remember. I can't remember. Yeah, and he had a barber shop. I didn't even know him. About him. About him. About him. About him. About him. About him. About him. About him. About him.
About him. About him. About him. About him. You remember Louis Lillet? I know Louis Lillet, yeah. Much. Much, I know.
He's the same as Duck. All of them out there in Barber.
